text:
Augustus III of Poland bought Correggio’s large Nativity altarpiece *The Adoration of the Shepherds*, known as *La Notte* (*The Holy Night*), in 1746 from Francesco III d’Este, Duke of Modena. Painted about 1528–1530 for San Prospero in Reggio Emilia, it hangs in the Gemäldegalerie Alte Meister in Dresden. That purchase also brought the *Madonna of St. Francis*, the *Madonna of St. Sebastian*, and the *Madonna of St. George*.
